info.description: Food, drink, and happy-hour items. Use the Restaurant dropdown to control and filter where each item appears.

allergens.description: Select every major allergen confirmed for this item. These selections appear as icons on the website.

restaurantScope.description: Controls website visibility and provides dropdown filtering. Choose all for every restaurant; choose multiple only when Locations contains more than one restaurant.

locations.description: Only required when Restaurant is multiple. Otherwise the Restaurant dropdown controls visibility.
